artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Read-only census. Wraps the S3 client so only get_object, head_object, list_objects_v2 (via paginator) are forwarded; every other operation raises. Enumerates partitions by listing gold.table_prefix(<table>) with Delimiter for continuation, sector_template, fund_form; typecast uses its fixed PARTITION. wanted is computed with the same producer call substrate.py makes for that table (lines 214, 248, 268, 281). OLD = sorted(docs)[-1] and RULE = highest method_version integer, then later LastModified, then greater key, both reimplemented in the file; no changed module picker is read. Budget 8000 requests and 1 GiB. Writes its own output with newline LF; no gold or silver writer is called.

Census output from one foreground run of ci1_census.py at worktree HEAD 1386eb78b9. 11 lines, LF only. PARTITIONS continuation n=95, sector_template n=10, fund_form n=3, typecast n=1. TABLE lines: continuation partitions=95 objects=446 input_match=95 no_input_match=0; sector_template partitions=10 objects=29 input_match=10 no_input_match=0; fund_form partitions=3 objects=12 input_match=3 no_input_match=0; typecast partitions=1 objects=4 input_match=1 no_input_match=0. No FALLBACK, EMPTY, SKIP, SLUG-MISMATCH or BUDGET-EXCEEDED line was printed.
